import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')

failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)

ERR = {"error":"input"}

# duplicate keys at several levels
for raw in [b'{"seed":"s","seed":"t"}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[],"channels":[]}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","name":"b","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h","host":"x"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}']:
    p = run_raw(raw); out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    check('dup '+raw[:40].decode('latin-1'), out, ERR)

# invalid utf-8 / BOM / trailing values / empty / non-object
for raw in [b'\xff\xfe{"seed":"s"}', b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"seed":"s"}', b'{"seed":"s"} {}',
            b'', b'   ', b'[]', b'"x"', b'1', b'null', b'{"seed":"s"}\n\n{"x":1}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[],}']:
    p = run_raw(raw); out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    check('raw '+repr(raw[:20]), out, ERR)

# nonfinite / overflowing exponents
for raw in [b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":NaN}', b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":1e999}',
            b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":Infinity}', b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":-Infinity}',
            b'{"seed":"s","timeout_ms":1.5e-310}' ]:
    p = run_raw(raw); out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    check('nonfinite '+repr(raw[-22:]), out, ERR)

# lone surrogates anywhere
for raw in [b'{"seed":"\\ud800"}',
            b'{"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":1,"cases":[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"\\ud800"}],"expect":{"method":"G","target":"/","host":"h"}}],"events":[],"channels":[]}']:
    p = run_raw(raw); out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    check('surrogate '+repr(raw[:24]), out, ERR)

check('float timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=1.0)), ERR)
check('string timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms="1")), ERR)
check('zero timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=0)), ERR)
check('big timeout', run(doc(timeout_ms=1000000001)), ERR)
check('timeout 1e9 ok', run(doc(timeout_ms=1000000000))['cases'], [])

check('missing root key', run(json.dumps(d)), ERR)
